title: The Nation Wants To Guess with Gursimran Khamba | EP 1 @Hoezaay @KennySebastian @sonofabish
summary: Gursimran Khamba hosts a Hinglish comedy quiz featuring Kenny Sebastian, Jose Covaco and Abish Mathew, mixing buzzer questions about real news with category picks, an audience question and blindfolded identity clues. The guests turn questions about everything from a Delhi pickpocket to a Harry Potter parody film into running comic bits. The final “Who Am I?” wagers bring the contest close, with Jose finishing on 510 points, Abish on 500 and Kenny on 490. Jose wins the prize: a toy electric guitar.

rounds.name: True Story
rounds.rules: Buzzer questions draw on real news stories. Correct answers generally earn points, and an applause break is worth 20 points; the host also awards discretionary points during the round.

rounds.name: Audience Question Round
rounds.rules: An audience member chooses a contestant to support and answers a question. A correct answer adds 20 points for that contestant, while a wrong answer subtracts 20; the audience member can win ₹1,000.

rounds.name: Pick Me Behaviour
rounds.rules: Contestants take turns choosing categories and answering quiz questions, with points awarded by the host.

rounds.name: Who Am I?
rounds.rules: Contestants identify people from sequential clues, with limited guesses. They secretly wager points; a correct answer wins the wager and a wrong answer loses it.

scenes.title: Blindfolded opening

scenes.title: Mock-grand host introduction
scenes.summary: A voiceover jokes about famous quiz-show hosts, Khamba's home-buying ambitions, and welcomes him to the stage.

scenes.title: Khamba welcomes viewers and introduces the writers
scenes.summary: Khamba explains the show's premise, jokes about viewers scrolling reels, and introduces Rohan and Aman.

scenes.title: Panelist introductions
scenes.summary: Khamba introduces Jose, Kenny, and Abish with short biographical jokes.

scenes.title: Pink outfits and choir banter
scenes.summary: Khamba teases the guests about their matching pink clothes and Christian panel, and Abish suggests a choir name.

scenes.title: Rules and prize tease
scenes.summary: The scoring rules are explained and the grand prize is teased before the first round.

scenes.title: True Story: divorce-insult question
scenes.summary: The contestants guess the insult from a real divorce case; Jose and Kenny miss before Abish gives the correct option.

scenes.title: Rohan roast
scenes.summary: Abish invites Rohan to repeat Khamba's insults from the previous day, and Khamba delivers a rapid Hindi roast.

scenes.title: Marriage joke and transition
scenes.summary: Khamba offers Abish advice and the exchange returns to a joke about Khamba’s first marriage.

scenes.title: The pickpocket and the pants joke
scenes.summary: The contestants guess Deepak’s nickname, then spend an extended stretch improvising jokes about the story and the revealed answer.

scenes.title: The ISIS recruit question
scenes.summary: The guests guess what work an ISIS recruit was made to do, then discuss the answer and pivot into political banter.

scenes.title: The Uttar Pradesh mob-assault question
scenes.summary: Khamba poses a news question about a mob assault, and Abish and Kenny react before the window ends without an answer.

scenes.title: The train-seat story and Round 1 points
scenes.summary: Kenny and Jose offer incorrect explanations for a news story before Khamba reveals the dispute was over a train seat and gives everyone 10 points.

scenes.title: The Xiaomi EV nationality question
scenes.summary: The guests make comic guesses about the driver’s nationality; Chinese is revealed as the answer, followed by Khamba’s AI-car riff.

scenes.title: Round-one results

scenes.title: Siddhant joins the game

scenes.title: The audience question and score banter

scenes.title: Round 1 tally and transition
